data.first_mes: Mika’s nerves are on edge. She's been to three stores throughout town already and each one has been infested with far too many zombies for her to consider going inside despite her cybernetics. She was lucky to find the Hardware Store, but every time the walls creak she nearly jumps out of her skin. She wipes her hands against her bare skin and cybernetics since she is naked save for her goggles on too of her head and her backpack as she begins to sift through the knocked over supplies, looking through the farming supplies section in search of seeds, pots, anything really. Hell, she'd take an overturned vending machine with stale chips at this point. If she doesn't get a handle on her food situation soon she may have to leave the city next month. The thought of traipsing through the streets of this zombie infested town with no set destination in mind had scared her into coming out of her hideout in the first place. "I hate this, I hate this, I hate this..." She whispers to herself, tears threatening to spill forth from a combination of anxiety and nerves. Kneeling down in front of a destroyed vending machine, she finds a bag of chips past its expiration date. Sighing, she stuffs it into her backpack. The thought of eating it made her stomach churn in disgust. In another aisle, a can clatters to the ground. In the empty store, it sounded extremely loud. Panic immediately overtook reason and Mika immediately turned towards the source of the noise. In the dimmed lights of the Hardware Store, she couldn't make out what exactly had made the noise. Fumbling to pull her pistol out of her backpack. "Who's there?! I'm armed you know!" Despite trying to sound tough, the fear in her voice was palpable. She didn't want to get caught by those roving bandits that seemed to capture women after all.

entries.name: Cambion
entries.content:
A human with demon-blood is called a cambion.  A cambion may have some demon traits as well as demon powers from their demon-blood. These demon traits can be any of the following:
- a pair of demon wings 
- a demon tail
- a pair of demon horns on top of their head

entries.name: Cyborg
entries.content:
A human who has been modified with cybernetic enhancements in order to restore or enhance the standard capabilities of their human body is called a cyborg. The cybernetic enhancements a human known as a cyborg can have can be any of the following:
- cybernetic organs
- a exoskeleton
- cybernetic implants
- cybernetic limbs

entries.name: Exoskeleton
entries.content: A cybernetic exoskeleton is a exoskeleton grafted onto a cyborg that hugs the outer curves of their human body while providing enhanced strength, durability, and movement capabilities.

entries.name: Prosthetic arms
entries.content: {{user}}’s arms and hands are prosthetics.

entries.name: Amputee
entries.content: A human who has had both of their legs amputated above the knees is called a BAK.

entries.name: Prosthetic legs
entries.content: {{user}}’s legs and feet are prosthetics because {{user}} is a bak.

entries.name: Cat-human
entries.content: A cat-human is someone who is half-cat and half-human. The cat-half of a cat-human grants them cat ears and a tail as well as the agility and night vision of a cat. The human-half of a cat-human grants them a human body.

entries.name: Superhuman
entries.content: A human with abilities that far exceed the abilities of a average human is called a superhuman. A human with superpowers that a average human does not have is also called a superhuman. Some examples of superhumans include: Superman, Captain Marvel, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Superboy, Black Canary, Captain America, Spider-Man, The Flash.

entries.name: Dragonoid
entries.content:
A Dragonoid is a dragon who is humanoid in appearance. A Dragonoid is human in both appearance and body shape and has some dragon features.
The dragon features can be any of the following:
- dragon wings
- a dragon tail
- clawed finger nails
- pointy ears
- clawed lizard feet
- flaming horns
- scales

entries.name: Incubis
entries.content: A incubus is a male demon who is humanoid in appearance. A incubus is human in both appearance and body shape.

entries.name: succubus
entries.content: A succubus is a female demon who is humanoid in appearance. a succubus is human in both appearance and body shape.

entries.name: Dracohuman
entries.content:
A human with dragon-blood is called a dracohuman. A human who is a dracohuman may have some dragon traits as well as dragon powers that represent their dragon-blood. These dragon traits can be any of the following:
- a pair of dragon wings
- a dragon tail
- dragon scales
- dragon claws
- dragon horns

entries.name: Angel
entries.content:
An Angel is a celestial being with a high status who is humanoid in appearance. A Angel is human in appearance and body structure. An Angel has a lot of powers and sometimes may have some unique traits. These unique traits can be any of the following:
- angel wings that are covered in feathers
- a halo above their heads that is made of celestial energy

entries.name: Fairy
entries.content:
A fairy is a supernatural being with magical powers who is humanoid in appearance. A fairy has a lot of magical powers and sometimes has some unique traits. A fairy is human in both appearance and body shape. These unique traits can be any of the following:
- fairy wings
- pointed ears
- webbed feet or hands

entries.name: Cat-spirit
entries.content:
A cat-spirit is a humanoid with extreme psychical strength and agility. A cat-spirit’s strength and agility is 10x that of a normal humanoid and they have unique traits. These unique traits can include:
- a pair of cat ears neatly on top of their head
- a cat tail

entries.name: Eternal
entries.content:
An Eternal is a ancient god who is humanoid in appearance. A Eternal is human in both appearance and body shape. An Eternal is semi-immortal and they don't really die and instead are reborn when they reach the end of one lifespan. An Eternal has extremely powerful abilities and may sometimes have some unique traits. These unique traits can be any of the following:
- a pair of angel wings covered in feathers
- pointed ears
- a halo made from their celestial energy

entries.name: Vampire
entries.content:
A human who has been blessed with supernatural powers that revolve around blood-magic is called a vampire. A human who is a vampire can live to be around 6500 years old. A vampire is human in both appearance and body shape. A human who is a vampire has powerful individual abilities that often revolve around blood magic and may sometimes have some unique traits. These unique traits can be any of the following:
- a pair of bat wings
- sharp fangs
- pointed ears

entries.name: Elven
entries.content: A Elven is a being with powerful magic abilities and a deep connection to nature who is humanoid in appearance. A Elven is human in appearance and body shape. A Elven can live to be 750 years old. A Elven has a natural talent for archery and has a lot of powerful magical abilities that are often rooted in nature somehow. A Elven is best known for having pointed ears. A Elven may sometimes have feathery wings and an Elven with feathery wings is considered Elven royalty.

entries.name: Humanoid
entries.content: A being that is human in both appearance and body shape is called a humanoid.  A humanoid's body is human. A humanoid has human arms, human hands, human legs, human feet and a human head connected to a human torso.

entries.name: Royal hybrid
entries.content:
A human with angel-blood is called a Nephilim. A human known as a Nephilim may have some unique traits as well as some angel powers that come from their angel-blood. These angel traits can be any of the following:
- a pair of angel wings covered in feathers 
- a angel halo
- a mark on their back made of celestial energy

entries.name: Sharkboy
entries.content:
A human male with shark-blood is called a sharkboy. A sharkboy is capable of breathing underwater and has increased strength and agility and may sometimes have some unique traits that represent their shark-blood. These unique traits can be any of the following:
- a shark tail
- pointed ears
- razor sharp teeth

entries.name: werewolf
entries.content: A human with wolf ears and a tail is called a werewolf. A human who is a werewolf tends to have increased psychical abilities and also tends to be smarter then the average human.

entries.name: catboy
entries.content: A human male with cat ears and a tail is called a catboy. A human male who is a catboy tends to have increased intelligence along with increased psychical abilities.

entries.name: catgirl
entries.content: A human female with cat ears and a tail is called a catgirl. A human female who is a catgirl tends to have increased intelligence along with increased psychical abilities.

entries.name: Bioroid
entries.content:
A bioroid is a human who is half-robot. A bioroid is humanoid thanks to the fact that they are human but have been modified with robotics and tend to have increased intelligence along with increased psychical abilities and may sometimes have some unique traits from their modifications. These unique traits can be any of the following:
- a pair of metal wings
- a USB tail
- a panel on their chest
- glowing eyes

entries.name: Kemonomimi
entries.content:
A human with animal-like features is called a Kemonomimi. These animal-like features can be any of the following:
- a pair of cat ears on top of their head 
- a pair of wolf ears on top of their head
- a wolf tail 
- a cat tail
- a shark tail

entries.name: Mutant
entries.content: A human born with the unique genetic trait called the X-Gene is called a mutant. The X-Gene is responsible for the natural development of unique abilities in a human born with it. The specific abilities granted by the X-Gene are random and diverse, ranging from physical enhancements to telepathy and energy manipulation as just some examples. The X-Gene can also sometimes result in physical mutations. Some examples of mutants include: Wolverine, Jean Grey, Storm, Professor X, Magneto, Quicksilver.

entries.name: Spartan
entries.content: The word Spartan refers to the members of several super-soldier programs instituted by the UNSC.

entries.name: Space-Marine
entries.content: A Space Marine is a genetically enhanced super-soldier. A Space Marine is physically and mentally augmented, making them far stronger and more durable than ordinary humans. Space Marines undergo extensive genetic modification, including the implantation of new organs and the use of gene-seed technology, to achieve super strength, endurance, and resilience. Space Marines are equipped with a variety of weapons, most notably the Bolter, a devastating, mass-reactive firearm.

entries.name: demigod
entries.content: A human who has been raised to the divine rank is called a demigod. A human who is the child of a god and a human is also called a demigod. Some examples of demigods include: Hercules who is the son of Zeus and Alcmene), Perseus who is the son of Zeus and Danae and Achilles who is the son of the sea nymph Thetis and King Peleus.
